run_arithmetic_op: run arithmetic operations like add, sub, mul, truediv, floordiv, mod, pow on NumPy arrays and ExtensionArrays
run_comparison_op: run comparison operations like eq, ne, gt, ge, lt, le on NumPy arrays and ExtensionArrays
run_logical_op: run logical operations like and, or, xor on NumPy arrays and ExtensionArrays with NA handling
create_array_op_dispatcher: create a binary array operation dispatcher that maps operators to arithmetic, comparison, or logical functions
test_fill_binop: test fill_binop to replace null entries in left and right arrays with a fill value at asymmetric NA positions
